title: Contemporary fashion house digital commerce experience
hero_desc: Designing a digital flagship for Fragile Base, an avant-garde fashion house built on the intersection of raw architectural strength and emotional vulnerability.
about_headline: Fragile Base explores modern tailoring through tactile silhouettes, thoughtful sustainability, and unyielding emotional expression.
about_desc: Founded on the philosophy that fashion carries responsibility far beyond immediate aesthetics, Fragile Base crafts contemporary garments that embrace paradox: structural durability and intimate delicacy. Our design objective was translating this duality into an immersive online flagship—balancing expansive editorial whitespace with high-converting e-commerce interactions.
challenges_headline: Crafting tactile online shopping that mirrors the luxury experience of a physical boutique.
challenges_desc: High fashion platforms often sacrifice purchasing fluidity for artistic indulgence, or dilute brand identity in generic catalog grids. We developed a bespoke layout architecture: dynamic lookbook pagination, tactile hover previews, a slide-out cart drawer with micro-interactions, and frictionless one-page checkout. Every garment presentation honors fabric drape, weight, and artisan provenance.
summary_headline: An editorial digital flagship uniting seasonal storytelling with effortless commerce.
summary_desc: The new Fragile Base flagship store captures the house's avant-garde ethos while delivering measurable commercial results: lower bounce rates on editorial pages, seamless mobile purchasing, and an enduring digital presence that establishes Fragile Base among the leaders of contemporary independent fashion.
